validation.notes.value: Primary PMC full text and figure legends checked 2026-09-27. Figure 3C explicitly reports uninjected n=41, dTrpA1 RNAi region 1 n=24, md-Gal4 n=23, UAS-TeTxLC n=30, and md-Gal4:UAS-TeTxLC n=23 larvae for hot-probe curling latency. Figure 4H reports dTrpA1-Gal4:UAS-TeTxLC n=19 and dTrpA1-Gal4:UAS-Hid n=20 in another probe comparison. These are panel/group counts, not a study-wide N. Figure 3B-C finds an assay-specific negative dTrpA1 RNAi comparison. No evoked neural recording, subjective pain, human ECAP or SCS outcome. The S282 c66 citation is reagent provenance. Classified included_core by the verified_primary review workflow with evidence_role method_baseline.
